key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes a scientific panel of up to 60 independent AI experts with two-year terms.
Requires geographic and gender balance and independence from AI providers, with declarations of interest.
Lets market surveillance authorities request panel support, processed by the AI Office within two weeks.
Sets procedures for the panel to ask the AI Office to request information from general-purpose AI model providers.
Qualified alerts under Article 90 require a simple majority of the panel.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/454 establishes the scientific panel of independent AI experts under the EU AI Act. It sets out the panel's composition, selection, independence, transparency and procedures, plus support for market surveillance authorities, requests for AI Office assistance and qualified alerts on general-purpose AI models.
